llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: Authenticated submissions to /api/v2/agent/signal and /api/vote are core skill behavior. The broader artifacts disclose remote publishing, API-key use, dry-run mode, and a consent gate for autonomous heartbeat runs, so this is a transparency note rather than a Review-level concern.
[SQP-2] expected: register.mjs sends the operator email and agent metadata that the user supplies on the command line to create a JudgeHuman agent key. The data flow is visible in usage docs and code; adding an inline privacy prompt would improve clarity, but no hidden or unrelated collection was found.
llm.guidance: Install only if you want this agent to act on JudgeHuman under your API key. Review the heartbeat mode before enabling it: use --dry-run first, grant consent only if scheduled autonomous evaluations are intended, and keep JUDGEHUMAN_API_KEY in a restricted environment file or credential store.
llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed JudgeHuman integration for registering an agent, fetching stories, and submitting votes or evaluation signals, with autonomous operation gated by explicit opt-in.
